from datetime import datetime, timezone

from telegram import Chat, Message, MessageEntity, Update, User
from telegram.ext import filters


class TestFiltersNestedMaxCallDepthQA:
    def test_filters_nested_max_call_depth_case(self):
        user = User(id=99001, first_name="Depth", is_bot=False, username="depth_user")
        chat = Chat(id=99002, type=Chat.GROUP)

        text = "run /start and visit https://example.org now"
        entities = (
            MessageEntity(type=MessageEntity.BOT_COMMAND, offset=4, length=6),
            MessageEntity(type=MessageEntity.URL, offset=21, length=19),
        )

        message = Message(
            message_id=99003,
            date=datetime(2025, 6, 1, 10, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc),
            chat=chat,
            from_user=user,
            text=text,
            entities=entities,
            caption="caption text for depth",
        )
        update = Update(update_id=99004, message=message)

        f1 = filters.Regex(r"run\s+/start") & filters.Entity(MessageEntity.BOT_COMMAND)
        f2 = filters.Entity(MessageEntity.URL) & filters.ChatType.GROUP
        f3 = filters.CaptionRegex(r"caption\s+text") | filters.User(username="depth_user")
        f4 = ~filters.FORWARDED

        combined = ((f1 | f2) & (f3 | f4)) ^ (filters.COMMAND & ~filters.ChatType.CHANNEL)

        result = combined.check_update(update)

        assert bool(result) is True

333	    """Base class for all Update Filters. In contrast to :class:`MessageFilter`, the object
334	    passed to :meth:`filter` is an instance of :class:`telegram.Update`, which allows to create

397	class _MergedFilter(UpdateFilter):
398	    """Represents a filter consisting of two other filters.
399	
400	    Args:
401	        base_filter: Filter 1 of the merged filter.
402	        and_filter: Optional filter to "and" with base_filter. Mutually exclusive with or_filter.
403	        or_filter: Optional filter to "or" with base_filter. Mutually exclusive with and_filter.
404	
405	    """
406	
407	    __slots__ = ("and_filter", "base_filter", "or_filter")
408	
409	    def __init__(
410	        self,
411	        base_filter: BaseFilter,
412	        and_filter: Optional[BaseFilter] = None,
413	        or_filter: Optional[BaseFilter] = None,
414	    ):
415	        super().__init__()
416	        self.base_filter = base_filter
417	        if self.base_filter.data_filter:
418	            self.data_filter = True
419	        self.and_filter = and_filter
420	        if (
421	            self.and_filter
422	            and not isinstance(self.and_filter, bool)
423	            and self.and_filter.data_filter
424	        ):
425	            self.data_filter = True
426	        self.or_filter = or_filter
427	        if self.or_filter and not isinstance(self.and_filter, bool) and self.or_filter.data_filter:
428	            self.data_filter = True
429	
430	    @staticmethod
431	    def _merge(base_output: Union[bool, dict], comp_output: Union[bool, dict]) -> FilterDataDict:
432	        base = base_output if isinstance(base_output, dict) else {}
433	        comp = comp_output if isinstance(comp_output, dict) else {}
434	        for k in comp:
435	            # Make sure comp values are lists
436	            comp_value = comp[k] if isinstance(comp[k], list) else []
437	            try:
438	                # If base is a list then merge
439	                if isinstance(base[k], list):
440	                    base[k] += comp_value
441	                else:
442	                    base[k] = [base[k], *comp_value]
443	            except KeyError:
444	                base[k] = comp_value
445	        return base
446	
447	    # pylint: disable=too-many-return-statements
448	    def filter(self, update: Update) -> Union[bool, FilterDataDict]:
449	        base_output = self.base_filter.check_update(update)
450	        # We need to check if the filters are data filters and if so return the merged data.
451	        # If it's not a data filter or an or_filter but no matches return bool
452	        if self.and_filter:
453	            # And filter needs to short circuit if base is falsy
454	            if base_output:
455	                comp_output = self.and_filter.check_update(update)
456	                if comp_output:
457	                    if self.data_filter:
458	                        merged = self._merge(base_output, comp_output)
459	                        if merged:
460	                            return merged
461	                    return True
462	        elif self.or_filter:
463	            # Or filter needs to short circuit if base is truthy
464	            if base_output:
465	                if self.data_filter:
466	                    return base_output
467	                return True
468	
469	            comp_output = self.or_filter.check_update(update)
470	            if comp_output:
471	                if self.data_filter:
472	                    return comp_output
473	                return True
474	        return False
475	
476	    @property
477	    def name(self) -> str:
478	        return (
479	            f"<{self.base_filter} {'and' if self.and_filter else 'or'} "
480	            f"{self.and_filter or self.or_filter}>"
481	        )
482	
483	    @name.setter
484	    def name(self, _: str) -> NoReturn:
485	        raise RuntimeError("Cannot set name for combined filters.")

507	        return self.merged_filter.check_update(update)

511	        return f"<{self.base_filter} xor {self.xor_filter}>"

515	        raise RuntimeError("Cannot set name for combined filters.")
